subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: Should Sessions ordering derive meaningful activity at read time from bounded recent event/transcript metadata, persist dedicated activity timestamp fields, or keep `updatedAt` ordering for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable choice affects Gateway RPC shape, row write load, parent/child rollup semantics, and which event classes count as meaningful.

options.title: Read-time projection
options.body: Derive the sort key and visible reason from bounded recent metadata so noisy background work does not rewrite parent rows just to decide ordering.

options.title: Persist activity fields
options.body: Add stored `lastEventAt`, `lastMeaningfulActivityAt`, and `lastVisibleConversationAt` fields with tested updates, rollups, and migration/doctor handling.

options.title: Defer model change
options.body: Keep `updatedAt` ordering until maintainers approve a broader session activity model.

recommendation.title: Read-time projection
recommendation.body: Derive the sort key and visible reason from bounded recent metadata so noisy background work does not rewrite parent rows just to decide ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest recent owner for the Sessions panel and adjacent Control UI session-management surface.
